notes.title: March Update!
notes.notes:
Hi Knights,

The team has been working hard this month getting ready for GDC! The Lighthouse has it’s own booth in the North Hall and we will also be demoing the game at the ID@Xbox booth on the 21st between 2pm-4pm. 

We’ve also been getting some great feedback from our Beta Knights and have been implementing some great fixes/updates based on their feedback. 

This months update is very small because there has been so much preparation for our booth, but here it goes. :D

[h1]Soundtracks are Here!![/h1]

We received the physical soundtracks and Mimi has been personally signing each one. We hope to get these out to you soon. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/195044260f50c567a35932a5a20ccbee35855d48.jpg[/img]
 

If you still want to purchase the soundtrack, you can do that [url=https://www.thelighthousegame.com/pre-order]HERE[/url]

We only have a limited number of these left so get it while supplies last.

[h1]Beta Testing[/h1]

Beta testing for the prologue has been going great and we’re so thankful for the Beta Knights for playing the prologue dozens of times to help us find every bug and for giving us great feedback to help make it a better experience.

Based on the feedback, we have a solid grasp of things we need to update and feel that we can move on to Beta testing Act 01. We will be posting a sign up sheet for anyone who is interested in Beta testing and that’s in an early access Kickstarter or Indiegogo tier after we get back from GDC.

For all of you Knights that are currently in the Beta test we will be dropping one last build for you this weekend. 

[h1]GDC[/h1]

The entire team will be at GDC this year! If you’re going to be there please stop by and say "hi" we would love to see you.

[b]Shadow Knights Studio Booth Info [/b]

GDC Play - North Hall #4017 (March 21st-23rd)

[b]ID@XBOX Booth Info [/b]

March 21st from 2pm - 4pm

We will be doing some raffles at GDC and even if your not coming to GDC you can still participate. We will be posting info about the raffles on our [url=https://twitter.com/Shadow_Knights_]Twitter[/url] page and [url=https://www.facebook.com/ShadowKnightsStudio/?ref=bookmarks]Facebook page[/url], so be sure to keep an eye out to win some cool prizes. :D


 [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/27915fe0ea5bf0bb579d0dbfab17da3c06e1fceb.png[/img]

[h1]News[/h1]
 
The Lighthouse was featured in Unreal Engines #EpicFriday Sizzle Reel. Check out the playground environment @26 seconds :D 

https://youtu.be/EfyiI35iThg?list=PLbRvdDViMnhco9hDNXxWIAqSE1X2OlYIc


We want to thank you all for your continued support, we couldn’t be doing this without you. We’re working hard to create a memorable game experience and you Knights are helping us accomplish that. Thank you!

-The Shadow Knights Team

notes.title: February Update!
notes.notes:
Hi Knights! 

We have some exciting updates this month! 

[h1]Prologue Beta Test[/h1]

Thank you to all of the Early Access Knights that signed up for the Private Beta. Our first round of testing will be for the Prologue.

If you didn't get to sign up for the beta test, no worries we will have more opportunities very soon. 

[h1]Voice Over Recording Session @Surf City Studios [/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/0e7337b6ddd3b888b510089ac76509e528010b52.jpg[/img]

[i]Maliya voice over recording for Lily Irvine[/i]

We went to Surf City Studios to do some voice over recording. We're very happy with the outcome and can't wait for all of you to hear our incredibly talented voice actors. For those of you in the beta test, you will be the first ones to hear these new recordings! 

[h1]The Lighthouse Original Soundtrack[/h1]

On January 5th, the Lighthouse Original Soundtrack by Mimi Page was released on all digital retailers.

For those of you that have listened to it, let us know what your favorite tracks are!

If you still want to purchase the Digital Soundtrack you can do so [url=https://mimipage.bandcamp.com/album/the-lighthouse-original-game-soundtrack]HERE[/url]. 

[h1]Physical Soundtrack[/h1]

We just ordered the physical soundtracks and here is the official album artwork! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/7c4ea19595ec2e3958fe85e5709546cfea7db40e.jpg[/img]
[i]This is a 6-panel CD made with eco-friendly materials.[/i]

If you would like to purchase the physical signed soundtrack, you can still do so [url=https://www.thelighthousegame.com/pre-order]HERE[/url]. 

There are a limited number of these left, so they will be available while supplies last. :) 

[h1]Social Media[/h1]

We started posting some sneak peeks of the game for #ScreenShotSaturday on all of our social media accounts. Here are some of the posts from the last couple weeks:

 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kNtvmp6EIqk] The Playground Environment  [/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/6wSZKSpEyq0]The Shed[/url]


 Be sure to follow us on Social media for even more updates! :D 

[url=https://www.facebook.com/ShadowKnightsStudio]Facebook[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/shadow_knights_studio/]Instagram [/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/Shadow_Knights_]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UClzBBzrZ2DdqRLO9PDN92sQ/featured?view_as=subscriber]Youtube[/url]
[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/WwsKcNf]Discord[/url]

[h1]Development Updates[/h1]

We're feeling really good about the progress on The Lighthouse and we're working hard to make sure that everything is polished and working well. The upcoming Beta test will help us polish even further and make sure that we are catching all of the bugs that may be present and working to improve pacing/mood/gameplay feel, etc...

We're currently tackling our largest environment which is the inside of the Wescott Manor. All of the placeholder assets that you saw in the original alpha demo have been replaced with brand new custom assets. This has added to the development time but we believe it's necessary and makes the experience and atmosphere unique to The Lighthouse. 

[h1]GDC 2018[/h1]

The team is preparing for the Game Developers Conference (GDC) next month! We will have a booth @GDC Play for the entire expo and we will be showing off the game at the ID@Xbox booth on Wednesday March 21st at 2PM! The team is very excited to be given this opportunity to display The Lighthouse at GDC.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/ef40dbd27ff1788218dff203e44b9b75595258ee.png[/img]

If you're going to be at GDC next month, let us know we would love to see you! :D 


Thank you all for your continued support. You all are the best Knights ever! 

-The Shadow Knights Team

notes.title: November Update!
notes.notes:
We first want to thank all of you Knights for all of the support you have given us.  The messages of encouragement and support keep us going especially when things are down, and we mean, really down, and we can't thank you enough for helping us push through. 

We cannot stress how important it is for us to make a quality game that is awesome no matter how long it takes!  We have been working non-stop on The Lighthouse and this month we have some stretch goal updates, environment updates, tech updates, and other awesome news to share with you! 

[h1]The Wescott Manor[/h1]

Inspired by the real life Gabriola Mansion in Vancouver Canada, Clinton Crumpler and Kurt Kupser created the stunning Wescott Manor.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/99e3f7955d4860517240957208e3a29dfb84b0df.jpg[/img]

Both Clinton and Kurt from Dekogon Studio have work featured in games like: Gears of War 4, Robo Recall, PlayerUnknown's Battleground. They've finished working on this beautiful piece for The Lighthouse. We’re so thankful we got to work with these two on this, as it’s the focal point of the game. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/627ea23aae049fd30db3c9f26bb968a5c7e351d9.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/1b78536214c09803e698ddfb43f37e4ab4421a1e.png[/img]

You can check out some of Clinton and Kurts work on [url=http://www.dekogon.com/projects]Dekogon.com[/url] where they hand build and deliver industry class content for all types of studios.

[h1]The Lighthouse Cove[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/3d9dfa6ed2053890c5edac4a7466b1386f5960bd.png[/img]

[url=https://www.artstation.com/richardvinci] Richard Vinci [/url] has re-created our Lighthouse Cove and we absolutely love it. Richard started working with us back in July and has been an amazing addition to the Shadow Knights Team.  We believe these updates have really given the environments that extra polish that really blurs the line between Indie and AAA quality.  Richard always finds ways to even amaze us!  

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/1db5a6374c8b5775dd76305eb9c26dd38359cc8c.png[/img]

[h1] Technical Upgrades [/h1]

-Flashlight upgrade [ Now uses an IES profile so it looks more like a flashlight from the 50s-60s ]

-Flashlight now bounces light off of Fog.

-All new high quality original models in the Cove now support up to 4K resolution.  Most placeholder assets are almost fully replaced with our own custom models.

-Subsurface scattering now supported on foliage. Light now bleeds through grass and leaves just like in real life.

-Volumetric Fog enabled. Lights now more naturally scatter when going through fog.

-Musical beat syncing. Music now syncs with certain game objects (like the lighthouse sweep).

-The moon and stars in the cove are the actual position they would have been in the  sky that date, latitude & longitude, and time of day.  It's probably not going to be noticed by most players but it's part of our commitment to building an authentic story and world.

This next photo gives a pretty good idea at the new rendering systems from 4.18 working together.  Volumetric Fog, Light Scattering, Volumetric Lighting( God Rays ), Subsurface Scattering on foliage ( gives leaves and grass that see-through light glow), etc.  The Settings Menu still allows you to enable or disable certain features so you can still run The Lighthouse smoothly on as many computers as possible.  For those of you that can run 4k content- be prepared because this game has a lot of rendering features that will really test your rig.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/10c72a29e2f203c0cd00117ed187b47e9863ba0e.png[/img]

[h1]The Shining[/h1]

Concept art for The Shining hedge maze by Daniah 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/bef4c902aa2addf9266e8e5a5f321b2838b74ece.jpg[/img]

in-game screenshot of the Shining hedge maze by Richard Vinci
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/94db78ba5f4dc490244fdfb67af21ef5a4011b71.png[/img]

 As you can tell, the success of our Crowdfunding Campaign and the backings of our Knights have elevated The Lighthouse game.  You can see how crowdfunding really helps indie developers realize their initial visions.  We hope you appreciate the near 1:1 representation from artwork to realtime render.  The stretch goals were supposed to be great additions to the main game and you can get a sense of the feelings that we are trying to evoke by watching the work-in-progress video:

[url=https://youtu.be/byR5q-Q0YSs] Watch on Youtube [/url]

[h1]GDC 2018!!! [/h1]

We're very excited to announce that The Shadow Knights Team will be at GDC this year, but not only that, we will have a booth for The Lighthouse! If you will be attending GDC please stop by and say hi :D
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/a96f6a95327ab9108dc6a0a8a66e31e9e8a7360d.png[/img]

[h1] Mimi Page Interview [/h1] 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/71a1c23d8b5a7c193113b1d1bce4d464c3fc2a50.jpg[/img]

Mimi recently did an interview with Electronic Colorado [url=http://electroniccolorado.com/interview-mimi-page-more-than-just-a-pretty-voice/]check it out!  [/url]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29864941/22a5edb20e1d552ac6042f00553c4fd0221292a8.png[/img]

Check out our discord for more frequent updates. We always like to drop in pics/clips of things we’re working on. It's also the best way currently to reach us as we all have the app on our phones/computers and check it frequently.

  [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/WwsKcNf] Click here to join the Discord[/url]

We want to thank everyone again for the amazing support.  As we continue to get closer to getting the game finished, we will probably seem a bit more radio silent but that's only because we will be completely involved in finishing up gameplay for the 2 game extending stretch goals as well as the main game.  There are still a lot of things to streamline and structure and we do have a few more major assets that we are waiting on before we officially hit Beta.  Thanks everyone!

-The Shadow Knights Team
